description.value: The Cowichan Aquatic Centre is a public swimming facility operated by the Municipality of North Cowichan, located in Duncan on southern Vancouver Island. It sits within North Cowichan's broader recreation portfolio, which includes sports fields, trails, and court sports. As a community aquatic centre, it may offer useful amenities for touring cyclists passing through the Cowichan Valley.
